item.coloph: thugs rje rol pa drug sbyang 'di / sprul sku dbyil gyis zhal bzang brag la las bton …
item.note: sprul-sku dbyil in the colophon refers to dbyil-ston khyung-rgod rtsal or dpon-gsas khyung-rgod rtsal. the appended pages 403 and 404 are relevant neither to this nor to the following title.
